the US Payments Forum published a primer this week that treats agent-initiated transactions as an entirely new class of payment initiation. the paper walks through open questions on consent, security, and interoperability that the industry still needs to settle.

ampersend has been answering those questions in production. agents transact over x402 rails with spend governance built in, and opt-in compliance screening powered by @trmlabs checks wallets against sanctions and fraud flags before settlement.
